text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One morning, I bump into Yaeno Muteki looking slightly dazed.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I'm truly sorry. I went to bed at the regular time last night, but…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: For some reason, when I closed my eyes, my mind began revisiting all the races and martial arts matches I've had, one after the other…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: And so, I simply lay there wide awake, heart pounding. This was a great misstep, I know.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It sounds like Yaeno Muteki struggled to get much rest.
